Location: San Francisco, CA

About the Role
We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Accessibility Designer to join our design team. In this role, you will champion inclusive design principles and ensure our digital products meet and exceed accessibility standards. You will work closely with UX designers, product managers, and engineers to embed accessibility into the entire design lifecycle, creating exceptional user experiences for people of all abilities. This is a mid-level position ideal for a designer with 2-5 years of hands-on experience in accessibility, user-centered design, and digital product development.

Responsibilities
- Lead accessibility audits and usability testing for web and mobile interfaces, identifying barriers and recommending actionable improvements aligned with WCAG 2.1 AA standards and beyond
- Collaborate with UX and UI teams to design accessible components, interactions, and workflows that accommodate diverse user needs including screen readers, keyboard navigation, and assistive technologies
- Develop and maintain accessibility guidelines, checklists, and design patterns to be integrated into the product design system and shared across the company
- Conduct research on emerging accessibility trends, tools, and best practices, and evangelize inclusive design principles within cross-functional teams
- Partner with front-end engineers to validate implemented accessibility features using tools such as Axe, Lighthouse, JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver
- Facilitate training sessions and workshops on accessibility awareness and implementation for design and engineering teams
- Participate in user research sessions with individuals with disabilities to gather qualitative feedback and inform iterative design improvements
- Advocate for accessibility compliance in product roadmaps and help prioritize accessibility-related issues alongside feature development

Requirements
- 2-5 years of professional experience designing accessible digital products, preferably within SaaS or web application environments
- Strong working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 guidelines, ARIA standards, and assistive technology capabilities
- Proficiency with accessibility testing tools such as Axe, WAVE, Lighthouse, and screen readers like JAWS, NVDA, or VoiceOver
- Solid foundation in UX design principles, interaction design, and responsive web design, with experience using Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD
- Familiarity with front-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript to effectively communicate with engineering teams
- Experience conducting usability testing and user research that includes participants with disabilities
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across design, engineering, and product teams
- A portfolio demonstrating accessible design solutions and problem-solving approaches in real-world projects

Nice to Have
- Certification such as IAAP Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies (CPACC) or Web Accessibility Specialist (WAS)
- Experience working in Agile or Lean UX environments
- Knowledge of international accessibility laws and standards such as ADA, Section 508, and EN 301 549
- Background in inclusive design frameworks or human factors psychology

Junior Cloud Operations Engineer

Location: Austin, TX

About the Role:
We are seeking a motivated Junior Cloud Operations Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team. This entry-level position is ideal for new graduates or engineers with up to two years of experience who are passionate about cloud infrastructure, automation, and scalable systems. You will work closely with senior engineers to support and maintain our cloud platform, ensuring high availability, performance, and security for our global network. This role offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge cloud technologies and an opportunity to grow your expertise in DevOps practices within a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Responsibilities:
- Assist in monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining cloud infrastructure across multiple environments using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack.
- Collaborate with the team to automate deployment, configuration, and scaling processes using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
- Support incident response and participate in root cause analysis to improve system reliability and reduce downtime.
- Help maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar tools to streamline software delivery.
- Work with container orchestration platforms including Kubernetes and Docker to manage microservices deployments.
- Contribute to documentation of operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.
- Participate in on-call rotations and provide tier-one support to quickly resolve alerts and issues.
- Engage in continuous learning to stay updated with emerging cloud technologies and best practices in infrastructure automation and security.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 0-2 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or systems administration roles.
- Familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and basic understanding of cloud networking, storage, and compute services.
- Hands-on experience or coursework with Linux system administration and scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or Go.
- Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible) and understanding of configuration management concepts.
- Basic knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
- Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively document processes and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have:
- Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK stack.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.
- Understanding of networking concepts including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, and firewalls.
- Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or equivalent.
- Exposure to security best practices in cloud environments and DevSecOps principles.

If you are eager to launch your career in cloud operations and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, this role offers an excellent platform to develop your skills and contribute to managing a large-scale, globally distributed infrastructure.

Process Engineer  
Location: New York, NY  

About the Role  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Process Engineer with 2-5 years of experience in manufacturing and operations to join a dynamic team focused on driving operational excellence. This role involves leveraging advanced process mining and data analytics technologies to identify inefficiencies, design process improvements, and implement solutions that enhance productivity and reduce costs. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working within complex manufacturing environments, strong problem-solving skills, and proficiency with process optimization frameworks and tools. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, including production, quality, and supply chain, applying data-driven insights to transform manufacturing operations.

Responsibilities  
- Analyze existing manufacturing processes using process mining tools and data analytics platforms to identify bottlenecks, waste, and opportunities for improvement  
- Collaborate with production, quality, and operations teams to design and implement process improvements that enhance throughput, reduce cycle times, and improve product quality  
- Utilize [Company] Process Mining technology alongside ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle to extract and interpret process data for actionable insights  
- Develop and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and workflow diagrams using BPMN or similar modeling standards  
- Lead root cause analysis sessions (e.g., using Six Sigma DMAIC methodology) to address operational issues and drive continuous improvement initiatives  
- Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and generate regular reports to track process performance and impact of implemented changes  
- Support change management activities by training stakeholders on new processes and tools, ensuring smooth adoption and compliance  
- Participate in cross-functional projects to integrate process improvements with digital transformation efforts, including automation and IoT-enabled manufacturing systems  

Requirements  
- Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline  
- 2-5 years of experience in process engineering, manufacturing operations, or continuous improvement roles within a discrete or process manufacturing environment  
- Proficiency with process mining software platforms, preferably [Company] or equivalent tools such as Minit or Disco  
- Strong working knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ECC/S4HANA, Oracle), MES, and data extraction techniques (SQL, Python scripting a plus)

HR Compliance Manager

Location: Minneapolis, MN

About the Role
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive HR Compliance Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that our human resources policies and practices comply with all federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations. You will collaborate closely with HR, legal, and business leaders to develop, implement, and maintain compliance programs that protect the organization and support a fair and equitable workplace. This position requires a strong understanding of HR compliance frameworks, employment law, and experience with compliance management systems and HRIS tools commonly used in the industry.

Responsibilities
- Develop, implement, and maintain HR compliance policies and procedures aligned with applicable labor laws including FLSA, FMLA, ADA, EEO, OSHA, and state-specific regulations.
- Conduct regular audits and risk assessments of HR processes to identify compliance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
- Partner with HR business partners and legal teams to interpret complex employment laws and provide guidance on compliance-related issues.
- Manage and maintain compliance records and documentation, ensuring accuracy and readiness for internal and external audits.
- Lead employee training initiatives on compliance topics such as anti-harassment, workplace safety, and data privacy.
- Monitor changes in employment legislation and best practices; update policies and communicate changes to stakeholders.
- Utilize HRIS systems (Workday, ADP, or [Company] Dayforce) to generate compliance reports and track key metrics.
- Support investigations of compliance violations and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues promptly.

Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
- 3-5 years of experience in HR compliance or a related HR generalist role with a compliance focus.
- In-depth knowledge of federal and state employment laws and regulations.
- Experience working with HRIS platforms such as [Company] Dayforce, Workday, or ADP for compliance reporting and audit preparation.
- Strong analytical skills with experience conducting compliance audits and risk assessments.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance across multiple teams.
- Familiarity with compliance training tools and eLearning platforms.
- Professional certifications such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or CCP preferred.

Nice to Have
- Experience in technology-driven HR environments or SaaS-based HR solutions.
- Knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, or other data privacy regulations impacting employee data.
- Experience with project management methodologies such as Agile or Lean in the context of compliance program implementation.
